C1323.title: Samsung Engineers Leak Source Code via ChatGPT
C1323.summary: After Samsung Electronics allowed use of ChatGPT, reports described misuse risks where employees entered internal information into ChatGPT. Reports said employees entered sensitive content such as source code, equipment measurement, or yield-related data into an external generative AI tool, and such content could be stored by the external service or used for training, creating data leakage and shadow AI governance risks when enterprises adopt generative AI tools.
